ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (21) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

Lamennais's quotations of Christ (Matthew 11:28; Matthew 16:25) are translated from the Russian wording, with lowercase pronouns as printed; «личность» (lichnost', 'personality') follows the standing terminology. The attribution «Китайский Кван-Хин» is kept as printed, "Chinese Kwan-Hin" (apparently Kwan-Yin, Guanyin), without emendation.

Source observation: [13] «Китайский Кван-Хин.»: the name looks like a transcription of Kwan-Yin (Guanyin), to whom this vow is usually ascribed; kept as printed ("Kwan-Hin") and recorded for verification.
